items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: So I was showing the kid and Cricket said, Daddy give me the horn. I gave it to him.

ctx.x: Well, I did that down around 10th Street. ... you don't remember. You were five years old. Living at 110th Street and I was practicing and these people lived under me, you know, like kids hear you play. So she told her mother that she wanted a trombone for Christmas. ... I taught this kid how to play Silent Night or something in about five minutes. So I think she was about five years old, couldn't have been over five. So I was showing the kid and Cricket said, Daddy give me the horn. I gave it to him. Say you…
Well, what advice did you give to, Joe Orange did you ever give ... some advice about learning how to play the trombone?
